findings.F1: In the falling agitated profile, an up day is followed by a next day below the coin's drift whatever its close location: up days fall by a mean unusual -0.98 % (t_day -2.54, 613 cases on 258 days). Up days closing in the 0.2–0.4 part of the range fall as much as those closing at the top: -1.89 % (t -2.62, n 49) against -0.72 % for 0.8–1.0 (t -1.96, n 213).
findings.F2: Close location does not grade the next-day fall after in-profile up days: the slope on location has t 0.23 (Spearman +0.05, 613 cases, 258 days). That matches the tested idea's failed supporting check, where the upper half minus the lower half was -0.51 %. The idea's positive main result comes from the up day itself, not from where the close sits.
findings.F3: The in-profile up-day fall grows with the day's range against its prior 20-day average: by quartile, +0.06 % (t 0.10), -0.36 % (t -0.71), -1.53 % (t -2.39) and -1.60 % (t -1.77), 135–136 cases each. The slope on the clipped range ratio is t -1.35 (Spearman -0.13, 542 cases, 225 days).
findings.F4: Outside the profile the same up days show neither the fall nor the grading: range quartiles give -0.08 %, -0.28 %, -0.00 % and -0.27 % (all |t| ≤ 1.4, 745 cases each), with a slope of t -0.96. The effect lives in falling agitated markets.
findings.F5: The in-profile up-day fall holds across coins and years. Five of six coins show about -0.85 % to -1.10 % (BTC t -2.68, LTC -2.00, XMR -2.04, ZEC -2.03, ETH -1.74), and XRP shows -0.54 % (t -0.51). Every year is negative: 2018 -1.45 %, 2019 -1.39 %, 2020 -0.32 %, 2021 -0.85 %.
findings.F6: The size of the effect is not the obstacle. Per case the total move is +0.50 % against a cost of 0.19 % per trade, and in-profile up days in the top two range quartiles move about -1.5 % (8 times that cost). The book failed on grading and Calmar (0.18), not on cost.
findings.F7: In-profile down days rebound strongly and in a graded way. The bottom r1 quintile gives +2.18 % (t 6.7, n 358) against +0.36 % out of profile, and the widest-range down days give +3.22 % (t_day 3.39, 140 cases, 66 days). This repeats the 12 falling agitated long rebound strategies the map already holds, so it is not proposed.

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, a day that closes higher than the day before is followed by a fall over the next day. The wider that day's high-low range against the coin's average range of the past 20 days, the larger the next-day fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a falling, agitated coin fades a wide up day for one day, and sizes the fade by how wide the day was relative to recent days rather than by where it closed.
ideas.name: falling agitated wide up-day fade
